title: Repair linear-axis crushed scatter, jet cmap, and fabricated R²
what: True log-log fit has slope 0.93 and R² = 0.97 (r = 0.98), not R² = 0.98

reader_questions.question: What is the true log–log R² and scaling exponent of parse time vs payload size?
reader_questions.expected: R² ≈ 0.97 (slope ≈ 0.93), much noisier than the claimed 0.98.

reader_questions.question: Why did linear axes fail on this dataset?
reader_questions.expected: Payload sizes span 4 orders of magnitude (~3 KB to ~30 MB), crowding small payloads into the origin.

reader_questions.question: What other defects from broken_plot.py were repaired?
reader_questions.expected: Removed the jet colormap, added explicit axis labels with units (KB, ms), and fixed the text size.
